name: Jishou Fuuma Miko Yayoi
source:
Hospital gets closed due to a series of disappearances. Popular shrine maiden internet idol girl at the request of a TV station agrees to perform a night ritual at the hospital. However, when staff members come for the girl in the morning, she is nowhere to be found. And only the camera that was recording the whole night tells the truth...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
醫院因一連串失蹤事件而關閉。一名受歡迎的神社巫女網路偶像應電視臺請求，同意在醫院舉行夜間儀式。然而，第二天早晨工作人員來接女孩時，她已經不知所蹤。唯一能揭示真相的，只有記錄了整晚過程的攝影機……

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndreview[/url]]
